snippet.title: Verho - Curse of Faces - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Yariv!

600 years ago, a curse fell upon the world, destroying most of civilization. "The Curse of the Face" - when someone sees even a fragment of another person's face, both instantly perish.
To protect themselves, most of the population wears special masks to conceal their faces.

To this day, no one knows what caused the curse, but many know where it  originated.

Yariv, the old, cursed land, is where you will journey in search of answers. 

Verho is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler game inspired by King's Field game series. 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017330/Verho__Curse_of_Faces/

We hope you will enjoy it!
